notes.title: Roll of Honnor
notes.content:
We think it would be fun to integrate the best players into the game's ID generator with all our supporters who attended to development last year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39516011/9ad51c162362e6d695c121fbe95a507bc93bf8b4.png[/img]

We remind you that you must use the pawn "Hapawn" in the "Elite" maze to activate the ID generator.

All the players who have reached a score of at least 1000 points (displayed in the general ranking of the game) can, if they wish, integrate the ID generator. 

All you have to do is to comment on this news, mentioning your identifier to integrate, in the next updates. Have fun ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39516011/8dbbe5ce93789e61dd14c892ad4bc38a2a370742.png[/img]

notes.title: Letters chievements fixed
notes.content:
Better RNG. The letters spawn rate from Supernova theme has been multiplied by 2. They also spawns earlier in the game. From the 11x11 mazes for the easier. 19x19 for the most difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39516011/377cd4e5984c338a579c4896968322cd97e53e18.png[/img]
